Video Platforms.instruction: Find identifiable individual films from original brands, creators, directors or production companies. Prefer original releases over reposts; exclude channel homepages and generic video lists.
Video Platforms.note: Public indexing and private video access limit coverage. Preserve access hashes. Page and search evidence do not establish that a film has been watched.

Award Archives.instruction: Find specific official award entries and trace each identifiable work to its original project source where possible. Award collections and curated articles are discovery starting points, not final references.
Award Archives.note: Award names, years and categories require work-specific evidence. Subscriptions and indexing may limit access; being listed in a discovery article does not verify an award.

Creative Press.instruction: Discover individual creative works and campaigns in editorial coverage, then prefer their original brand or creator project pages. Use roundup articles as leads rather than standalone references.
Creative Press.note: Editorial descriptions and credits must be attributed to the specific source. Paywalls, incomplete credits and secondary reporting may limit verification.

Brand Film Showcases.instruction: Find specific brand and corporate films with identifiable titles and source evidence. Follow relevant example articles to the original individual production rather than returning a collection.
Brand Film Showcases.note: Commercial example lists are discovery material, not independent validation of production quality, metrics, credits or reproduction rights.

Studios & Agencies.instruction: Search the wider web for individual project pages from studios, directors, agencies and production companies. Do not restrict discovery to a fixed studio list or return general portfolio homepages.
Studios & Agencies.note: An empty domain list means open web discovery. Source identity and production credits remain provisional until supported by the original project page.

Web & Interactive.instruction: Find identifiable individual websites and interactive projects with original project or creator links. Exclude general galleries, template collections and inspiration homepages as final references.
Web & Interactive.note: Readable project evidence does not mean the interactive experience was tested. Awards, implementation techniques and outcomes require source-specific evidence.

Podcasts & Interviews.instruction: When this optional category is selected and relevant to the brief, find individual podcast episodes or interviews. GQ is a preferred discovery source, not a mandatory source on every search. Prefer identifiable original episode pages.
Podcasts & Interviews.note: This category is optional like all others. Episode or article evidence does not establish that audio was listened to or video watched; do not return generic show homepages.

Social Platforms.instruction: Find public indexed individual Reels, posts or Pins with clear work identity and attribution. Trace reposts to original creators where possible; exclude profiles and general inspiration boards.
Social Platforms.note: Public indexing and login restrictions limit coverage. Social availability does not establish original authorship or image and video reproduction permission.
